$2 = \dfrac{4}{A - 4}\left(48\right)$

$A - 4 = 96$

$A = 100$

questions.q: One milligram of matter converted into energy will give
questions.solution:
Given, the mass of the matter $= 1\text{m}\text{g} = 1 \times {10}^{- 6}\text{k}\text{g}$

As we know, $c = 3 \times {10}^{8}{m s}^{- 1}$

The matter will be converted into energy by the formula, $E = mc^{2}$

$= 1 \times {10}^{- 6} \times {\left(3 \times {10}^{8}\right)}^{2}$

$= 1 \times {10}^{- 6} \times 9 \times {10}^{16}$

$= 9 \times {10}^{10}\text{J}$

questions.q: A sample contains a large number of nuclei. The probability that a nucleus in the sample will decay after four half-lives is-
questions.solution:
The probability that a nucleus will not decay is-

$\left(\dfrac{N}{N0}\right) = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)n = q$

When n is the number of half-lives

$q = {\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right)}^{4} = \dfrac{1}{16}$

The probability that a nucleus will decay is

$p = 1 - q = 1 - \dfrac{1}{16} = \dfrac{15}{16}$
